id_source: NOT in the the reference pack instance. Ids verified against a reference 1.20.1 Forge jar taken from another instance on this machine - correct for the mod, but they will not resolve in this pack until the mod is added.
no_video_evidence: transcription did not complete for this mod; human_notes below are jar-derived only

order: [jar] waystones:warp_stone is the keystone of the whole mod - emerald + ender pearl + amethyst shard. EVERY craftable waystone variant lists it, so it is the real tier-1 gate.
[jar] waystones:warp_dust (ender pearl + amethyst shard) is the parallel cheap line, feeding waystones:attuned_shard and waystones:warp_plate.

[jar] waystones:waystone (stone bricks + obsidian + warp_stone) is the first placeable, then the cosmetic variants: waystones:mossy_waystone, waystones:sandy_waystone, waystones:deepslate_waystone, waystones:blackstone_waystone, waystones:end_stone_waystone.

[jar] the consumable travel items - waystones:warp_scroll, waystones:return_scroll, waystones:bound_scroll - all need paper plus gold nuggets and purple dye, and are the cheap alternative to placing stones everywhere.
[jar] waystones:sharestone and its 16 colours, plus waystones:portstone and waystones:warp_plate, are the network/automation tier.
gates: [jar] amethyst shards and ender pearls gate everything. Nothing in the mod is craftable before a geode and an Enderman.

[jar] DEPENDENCY: waystones recipes reference the balm library (balm:emeralds, balm:gold_nuggets, balm:purple_dyes). balm is NOT installed in the reference pack, so waystones could not load even if the jar were dropped in.
